Title: Book a Single room end to end with dates chosen on the home page
Preconditions: Browser open. Single room free for 09/11/2026–11/11/2026.
Steps:
1. Open https://automationintesting.online.
2. In "Check Availability & Book Your Stay", set Check In and Check Out to the test data dates.
3. Click "Check Availability".
4. In "Our Rooms", on the Single card click "Book now".
5. Check the address bar URL.
6. In the "Book This Room" panel, click "Next" until November 2026 and check the calendar.
7. Check the Price Summary.
8. Click "Reserve Now".
9. Type the contact data into Firstname, Lastname, Email, Phone.
10. Click "Reserve Now" again.
11. Check the "Book This Room" panel.
Test Data:
Check In: 09/11/2026
Check Out: 11/11/2026
Firstname: Maria
Lastname: Gonzalez
Email: maria.gonzalez@example.com
Phone: +523312345678
Expected Result:
Step 4: "Our Rooms" lists the Single card.
Step 5: URL is https://automationintesting.online/reservation/1?checkin=2026-11-09&checkout=2026-11-11.
Step 6: November calendar shows the "Selected" bar on 9 and 10 November (not on other days).
Step 7: Price Summary shows £100 × 2 nights = £200, Cleaning fee £25, Service fee £15, Total £240.
Step 8: Form with Firstname, Lastname, Email, Phone and a "Cancel" button appears.
Step 11: Panel is replaced by "Booking Confirmed", the text "Your booking has been confirmed for the following dates:" and 2026-11-09 - 2026-11-11, plus a "Return home" button. No red error box, no error page.
Notes: Assumption: the range end shown is the check-out date. Shared demo app: if the dates are already taken, shift both dates +7 days and recompute expected values.
Change from v3: Step 6 no longer depends on the run date.
